description: This file contains unit tests for the ObsService component of the OpenMRS medical record system. It verifies functionalities such as saving, retrieving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting Obs (observations), handling complex data (like images), managing obs groups hierarchically, and filtering observations by various criteria. The tests ensure correct interaction with the database, external files for complex data, and proper handling of associated references and cascading behaviors.

classes.name: ObsServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ObsService component of OpenMRS, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for integration testing within the application context.
